description_en: Replies to a pending user interaction in a DataAgent session
description_zh: 回复 DataAgent 会话中等待处理的用户交互
name: ReplyAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC protocol version. Fixed to 2.0
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC correlation ID for the current reply request. It is returned as-is in the response and is different from PermissionRequestId
parameters.help_zh: 本次回复请求的 JSON-RPC 关联标识，响应中原样返回；与 PermissionRequestId 不同
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The answers to ask_user_question. The key is a 0-based string index of the question, and the value is the answer text. Fill in each question one by one for multiple questions. Omit this parameter for general tool authorization or cancellation
fields.help_zh: ask_user_question 的答案，键为从 0 开始的问题下标字符串，值为回答文本；多个问题逐项填写。普通工具授权或取消时省略
fields.name: answers

fields.help_en: Required and cannot be empty when Outcome is selected. It takes the optionId of the actual option in the options of the current event (when submitting an answer, the option with kind=allow_once is usually selected). Omit this parameter when Outcome is cancelled
fields.help_zh: Outcome=selected 时必填且不能为空，取本次事件 options 中实际选项的 optionId（提交答案通常选择 kind=allow_once 的选项）；Outcome=cancelled 时省略
fields.name: option_id

fields.help_en: The processing type. selected indicates that an option is selected, and cancelled indicates that the user explicitly cancels the interaction
fields.help_zh: 处理类型：selected 表示选择一个选项；cancelled 表示用户明确取消
fields.name: outcome

fields.help_en: The processing result of the user for the current interaction
fields.help_zh: 用户对本次交互的处理结果
fields.name: outcome

fields.help_en: The identifier of the current permission_request. It is obtained from _qwen/notify.params.data.requestId of the original SSE, and is not ToolCallId, HTTP RequestId, or the current JSON-RPC Id. It cannot be . or
fields.help_zh: 当前 permission_request 的标识。取自原 SSE 的 _qwen/notify.params.data.requestId，不是 ToolCallId、HTTP RequestId 或本次 JSON-RPC Id；不能为 . 或
fields.name: permission_request_id

fields.help_en: The LSP session ID. Use the SessionId returned when creating the session, not the internal session ID of the daemon
fields.help_zh: LSP 会话标识。使用创建会话返回的 SessionId，不是 daemon 内部会话 ID
fields.name: session_id

JsonRpcResponse.description_en: The JSON-RPC response. Returns Result on success and Error on protocol errors
JsonRpcResponse.description_zh: JSON-RPC 响应。成功时返回 Result，协议错误时返回 Error

Error.description_en: The JSON-RPC fault message. For example, DAEMON_PERMISSION_UNAVAILABLE is returned when the daemon reply feature is not enabled
Error.description_zh: JSON-RPC 错误信息。例如 daemon 回复功能未启用时返回 DAEMON_PERMISSION_UNAVAILABLE

Data.description_en: The optional additional error information. The content depends on the error type
Data.description_zh: 可选的错误附加信息；内容取决于错误类型
Data.title_en: 可选的错误附加信息；内容取决于错误类型。
Data.title_zh: 可选的错误附加信息；内容取决于错误类型。

Message.example: DataAgent daemon permission reply is not enabled

Error.title_en: JSON-RPC 错误信息。例如 daemon 回复功能未启用时返回 DAEMON_PERMISSION_UNAVAILABLE。
Error.title_zh: JSON-RPC 错误信息。例如 daemon 回复功能未启用时返回 DAEMON_PERMISSION_UNAVAILABLE。

Id.description_en: The JSON-RPC correlation ID for the current reply request
Id.description_zh: 本次回复请求的 JSON-RPC 关联标识
Id.title_en: 本次回复请求的 JSON-RPC 关联标识。
Id.title_zh: 本次回复请求的 JSON-RPC 关联标识。

Result.description_en: The reply processing result. It only indicates whether the current reply is accepted, and does not indicate that the original task execution is completed
Result.description_zh: 回复处理结果；仅表示是否接受本次回复，不表示原任务执行完成

Accepted.description_en: Indicates whether the daemon accepts the current reply. A value of true indicates that the reply is accepted. A value of false indicates that the reply is not accepted, which may be because the request is unknown, already processed, expired, or the session does not exist. The specific cause cannot be distinguished based on this value
Accepted.description_zh: true 表示 daemon 接受本次回复；false 表示未接受，可能是请求未知、已处理、已过期或会话不存在，不能据此区分具体原因
Accepted.title_en: true 表示 daemon 接受本次回复；false 表示未接受，可能是请求未知、已处理、已过期或会话不存在，不能据此区分具体原因。
Accepted.title_zh: true 表示 daemon 接受本次回复；false 表示未接受，可能是请求未知、已处理、已过期或会话不存在，不能据此区分具体原因。

Timestamp.description_en: The response time. It is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 响应时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
Timestamp.title_en: 响应时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。
Timestamp.title_zh: 响应时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID for the current call, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的请求标识，可用于问题排查
